segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the cabinet to pick up the building block toys.
The robot arm grasps the building block toys from the top of the cabinet.
The robot arm lifts the building block toys from the cabinet.
The robot arm moves the building block toys towards the black bowl.
The robot arm places the building block toys into the black bowl.
The robot arm releases the building block toys into the black bowl.
The robot arm retracts from the black bowl after placing the toys.
